boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Michael's College
boards.description: Ten documented food destinations in Colchester and greater Burlington with currently listed late service or closing times.

cards.title: Wings Over Burlington
cards.subtitle: 150 Dorset Street, South Burlington
cards.notes: Check the day-specific listing before leaving: the official location page shows service until 1 a.m. Monday–Tuesday and 2 a.m. Wednesday–Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A South Burlington chicken-and-tenders stop with late closing times listed directly by the restaurant.
cards.evidence_claim: Wings Over Burlington lists hours through 1 a.m. Monday and Tuesday, and through 2 a.m. Wednesday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Mon–Tue 4 p.m.–1 a.m.; Wed–Sun 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Verify before travel.

cards.title: Crispy Burger
cards.subtitle: 160 North Winooski Avenue, Burlington
cards.notes: Use the listed day-by-day hours when planning a pickup; Friday and Saturday are shown open until 2 a.m., with several other late nights.
cards.short_summary: A downtown fast-food restaurant with published late-night hours on a Burlington visitor organization’s page.
cards.evidence_claim: Love Burlington lists Crispy Burger open until 1:30 a.m. on several days and until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours include 1:30 a.m. Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday; 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Kountry Kart Deli
cards.subtitle: 155 Main Street, Burlington
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday visit, check the current night-owl schedule and menu first; reporting says the deli serves 10 p.m.–3 a.m. those nights.
cards.short_summary: A downtown deli whose late-night weekend reopening was reported in 2026.
cards.evidence_claim: Seven Days reported that Kountry Kart Deli began Friday and Saturday late-night service from 10 p.m. to 3 a.m. on June 26, 2026.
cards.source_title: BTV’s Kountry Kart Deli Reopens Late; Judi’s Ice Cream Expands
cards.access_notes: Reported current late-night hours are Friday and Saturday, 10 p.m.–3 a.m.; confirm before going.

cards.title: Al's French Frys
cards.subtitle: 1251 Williston Road, South Burlington
cards.notes: Plan for an early-late stop rather than midnight: the restaurant’s site lists Sunday–Thursday service through 11 p.m. and provides its address.
cards.short_summary: A South Burlington counter-service destination with 11 p.m. hours on most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Al's French Frys lists Sunday through Thursday hours of 10:30 a.m. to 11 p.m. at 1251 Williston Road.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Sun–Thu 10:30 a.m.–11 p.m. Check the site for Friday and Saturday hours.

cards.title: Applebee's Grill + Bar
cards.subtitle: 155 Dorset Street, Burlington
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online-order or dine-in options if an 11 p.m. finish fits your schedule; all seven days are currently listed with the same closing time.
cards.short_summary: A family dining restaurant on Dorset Street with a consistent 11 p.m. listed close.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee's Burlington lists restaurant hours of 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in and takeout options, with 11 a.m.–11 p.m. hours daily.

cards.title: Juniper Bar & Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Hotel Vermont, 41 Cherry Street, Burlington
cards.notes: For a weekend meal, review the Hotel Vermont page before heading downtown; it lists Friday–Saturday service until 11 p.m. and says dinner is available during open hours.
cards.short_summary: Hotel Vermont’s restaurant lists 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday hours and full dinner-menu availability during open hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hotel Vermont lists Juniper open Friday and Saturday from noon to 11 p.m., with the full dinner menu available during open hours.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Fri–Sat noon–11 p.m.; full dinner menu is available during open hours. Confirm seating availability.

cards.title: Hen of the Wood Burlington
cards.subtitle: 55 Cherry Street, Burlington
cards.notes: Reserve or contact the restaurant ahead when a 10 p.m. dinner window works; its Burlington listing gives daily dining hours and a direct phone number.
cards.short_summary: A Cherry Street restaurant with dining listed through 10 p.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Hen of the Wood lists its Burlington dining room at 55 Cherry Street as open from 5 to 10 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Burlington dining 5–10 p.m. daily. Reservations or availability should be checked directly.

cards.title: Ken's Pizza and Pub
cards.subtitle: 71 Church Street, Burlington
cards.notes: Aim for Thursday through Saturday if you need the latest listed close; the restaurant posts 10 p.m. hours on those nights and notes takeout can be limited.
cards.short_summary: A Church Street pizza restaurant with 10 p.m. posted hours Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Ken's Pizza and Pub lists closing at 10 p.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday at its 71 Church Street location.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Thu–Fri noon–10 p.m. and Sat 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; kitchen and takeout availability may vary.

cards.title: Frankie's
cards.subtitle: 169 Cherry Street, Burlington
cards.notes: Book ahead or call for a same-night table; the restaurant says it opens nightly at 5 p.m. and takes its final seating at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Cherry Street dinner restaurant with a clearly published 10 p.m. final seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Frankie's states it is open seven days a week at 5 p.m. and that its last seating is always at 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists service nightly from 5–10 p.m., with final seating at 10 p.m.; reservations are recommended.

cards.title: The Daily Planet
cards.subtitle: 15 Center Street, Burlington
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s published Friday schedule for a later dinner: the menu highlight page lists Friday service from 5 p.m. to midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Burlington restaurant with an official Friday midnight listing on a current menu feature.
cards.evidence_claim: The Daily Planet's menu-highlight page lists Friday hours of 5 p.m. to midnight.
cards.source_title: The Daily Planet — Menu Highlight: Grenade
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday 5 p.m.–midnight. Confirm current menu and service hours before departure.
